verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI supports LLM-based structured extraction alongside CSS/XPath strategies, letting developers describe desired data instead of writing selectors, and community feedback confirms it solves LLM-scraping extraction headaches. However, evidence shows this typically still requires configuring an extraction schema/strategy rather than pure freeform natural language querying, and production-quality caveats (policy layer, quality gates) are noted by users.
